*   [beehive.lua (⭐24)](https://github.com/drhayes/beehive.lua) - A functional behavior tree implementation.
*   [Luafinding (⭐44)](https://github.com/GlorifiedPig/Luafinding) - Class-based A\* implementation written purely in Lua.

### Camera

*   [cam11](https://notabug.org/pgimeno/cam11) - Camera library that leverages the Transform object introduced in love2d 11.0+.
*   [parallax (⭐21)](https://github.com/idbrii/love-parallax) - Parallax scrolling with any camera system; seamlessly tile background images.

### Development

*   [LoveDebug (⭐42)](https://github.com/flamendless/lovedebug) - Inline console-like debugger utility.
*   [loveprofiler (⭐11)](https://github.com/dknight/loveprofiler) - LoveProfiler is an extremely simple logger and profiler.
*   [vudu (⭐48)](https://github.com/deltadaedalus/vudu) - Broad in-game debugging gui with a console, variable browser/editor, speed controls, and more.

### Drawing

*   [grove.draworder (⭐19)](https://github.com/FloatingBanana/Grove/blob/master/grove/draworder.lua) - Similar to deep, but you can set a custom sorting method and create multiple, nestable instances.

### Entity

*   [ecs-lua (⭐217)](https://github.com/nidorx/ecs-lua) - ECS Lua is a fast and easy to use ECS (Entity Component System) engine for game development.

### Helpers

*   [grove.color (⭐19)](https://github.com/FloatingBanana/Grove/blob/master/grove/color.lua) - Blend, convert and interpolate colors using 'color objects'.
*   [lua-state-machine (⭐393)](https://github.com/kyleconroy/lua-state-machine) - Lua Finite State Machine.
*   [Manami (⭐58)](https://github.com/MikuAuahDark/NPad93/blob/master/manami.lua) - An improved "reflowprint" with UTF-8, multicolor, and justify support.
*   [YAS](https://github.com/kithf/yas) - Yet Another Screen manager.
*   [Scenery (⭐43)](https://github.com/paltze/scenery) - A dead simple scene/state management system.
*   [GameStateManager (⭐18)](https://github.com/GwyrddGlas/GameStateManager) - A lightweight, optimized, and easy-to-implement solution for efficient game state management.

### Input

*   [GamepadGuesser (⭐20)](https://github.com/idbrii/love-gamepadguesser) - Get the right button icons for gamepads; load updated gamepad db.
*   [Kazari (⭐14)](https://github.com/MikuAuahDark/Kazari) - Multitouch gesture and input library.

### Performance

*   [AppleCake (⭐28)](https://github.com/EngineerSmith/AppleCake) - Profiling library for LÖVE, with detailed profiling and thread support.

### Platforms

*   [LÖVE Potion (⭐642)](https://github.com/lovebrew/lovepotion) - Unofficial implementation of the LÖVE for Nintendo (3DS, Switch and Wii U) Homebrew.

### Shaders

*   [ShaderScan (⭐13)](https://github.com/idbrii/love-shaderscan) - Adds hot reload, includes, and better error messages for faster shader iteration.

### Tweening

*   [NAniTe (⭐58)](https://github.com/MikuAuahDark/NPad93/blob/master/nanite.lua) - Timeline-based animation system that supports forward and backward update.

### UI

*   [cimgui-love](https://codeberg.org/apicici/cimgui-love) - LÖVE module for Dear ImGui obtained by wrapping cimgui (programmatically generated C-api) using LuaJIT FFI, easy to update to the latest Dear Imgui version.
*   [Layouter (⭐20)](https://github.com/nekromoff/layouter) - A simple UI **grid layout** library for LÖVE 2D game engine.
*   [Slicy (⭐16)](https://github.com/wqferr/slicy) - A newer 9patch/9slice library fixing some issues with Patchy.
*   [YUI](https://gitea.it/1414codeforge/yui) - Declarative UI library for LÖVE.
*   [Inky (⭐82)](https://github.com/Keyslam/Inky) - Any-purpose GUI framework.

### Utilities

*   [nativefs (⭐46)](https://github.com/EngineerSmith/nativefs) - Read and write files outside of LÖVE's allowed paths.

### Distribution

*   [LÖVE Actions](https://github.com/love-actions) - Build & deploy cross-platform game packages on ***ALL*** popular platforms. Supports Android, iOS, Linux, maxOS, Windows.
*   [love-fuser (⭐19)](https://github.com/MikuAuahDark/love-fuser) - Packages LÖVE Games using GitHub Actions. Supports Windows, Linux, and Android.
